items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she organized the band here and we just went down.

ctx.x: She organized the band here in New York?
Yeah, she organized the band here and we just went down. There wasn't that many dates in the two weeks and I'll never forget in Knoxville we only had about twenty people.
That's the first time you met Jonah, I guess.
